user.title: Describe the house
user.description: Pick one temperature sensor per room (dedicated wall sensors work best), an outdoor temperature source, and the thermostat. Solar power is used as a proxy for sunlight; fan and ventilation are optional on/off signals such as an HRV status. History already in the recorder is used for training straight away.

error.no_rooms: Select at least one room sensor.
error.outdoor_is_room: The outdoor source cannot also be a room.

init.title: Describe the house
init.description: Changing a room or source starts a new data column for it; data for removed entities is dropped.

export_dataset.name: Export training data
export_dataset.description: Write the collected training set and fitted model to thermal_mpc_dataset.yaml in the config folder, for offline analysis. Overwrites the previous export.
